title: Private observability minimum pack — GA readiness checklist
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Goal: ship Private Observability Minimum Pack as a supported GA feature (VPC + on-prem/air-gapped), with validated artifacts, support readiness, and clear ownership.

This ticket is the GA gate/checklist for the Private observability minimum pack. All boxes must be checked before tagging the release branch and announcing GA internally.

Scope of GA gate (what “ready” means):
- Validations complete (VPC + on-prem-like / air-gapped simulation)
- Support enablement complete (playbooks, known-issues, escalation paths)
- Release notes drafted and reviewed (upgrade/rollback notes, breaking changes)
- Ownership clarified for dashboards/rules/log collector configs + ongoing triage

GA checklist

1) Engineering artifacts shipped + versioned
[✓] observability-pack contains versioned dashboard bundle for Private (runtime + control plane + infra)
    - Ref: sources/github/observability-pack/pr-18341-add-private-minimum-pack-dashboard-bundle.json
[✓] baseline Prometheus recording rules + alerts for latency/availability
    - Ref: sources/github/observability-pack/pr-18356-add-private-prometheus-alert-rules-latency-and-availability.json
[✓] GPU saturation/OOM/resource pressure alerts included with tuned defaults
    - Ref: sources/github/observability-pack/pr-18372-add-gpu-saturation-and-oom-alerts.json
[✓] Helm charts wire in dashboards/rules/log configs behind values with sane defaults
    - Ref: sources/github/redwood-helm-charts/pr-18405-wire-observability-pack-into-private-values.json
[✓] Private installer preflight checks + post-install validation steps merged
    - Ref: sources/github/redwood-private-installer/pr-18422-add-observability-preflight-and-postinstall-validation.json
[✓] Air-gap/offline bundle contains dashboards/rules/log configs + manifest updated
    - Ref: sources/github/redwood-private-installer/pr-18441-include-offline-observability-artifacts-in-airgap-bundle.json

2) Validation complete (must-have)
[✓] Smoke tests pass in CI (install -> verify scrape targets -> dashboards render -> alerts fire under injected failures)
    - Ref: sources/github/redwood/pr-18544-add-private-observability-smoke-test-harness.json
    - Linear: ENG-19156
[✓] Failure injection validations executed:
    - block Prometheus scrape (NetworkPolicy) -> alert + runbook steps
    - induce pod restart loop -> alert + dashboard shows increase
    - induce GPU pressure / OOM kill -> alert + panels update
    - simulate log forwarder backpressure -> warning surfaced + no cluster instability
[✓] Upgrade/rollback validations executed:
    - upgrade from previous private chart version -> dashboards still load
    - rollback after upgrade -> no dangling resources / broken datasources
    - metric rename/migration notes validated (no silent empty panels)
    - Linear: ENG-19155
[✓] Air-gapped validation done using offline bundle manifest + checksums
    - Linear: ENG-19154

3) Support readiness
[✓] Day-2 ops runbook published (install/upgrade verification, common failure modes)
    - Confluence: private-observability-day2-runbook
    - Linear: ENG-19158
[✓] Known issues page updated with workarounds and links to runbooks
    - Confluence: private-observability-known-issues
[✓] Oncall-facing alert annotations include “what to do first” and runbook links
    - Confirmed per oncall feedback thread (runbook URLs in alert descriptions)
[✓] Support enablement session completed (Support + SRE) covering:
    - dashboards blank after upgrade
    - Prometheus scrape failures
    - Splunk HEC auth errors
    - alert noise tuning guidance and disablement policy
    - owners + escalation routing

4) Security/compliance gate
[✓] Security review complete for log redaction + retention defaults
    - Linear: ENG-19157
    - Notes:
      - request/response payload logging remains off by default
      - request_id allowed; tenant_id stored as hash only
      - guidance included for customer SIEM retention and restricted access
[✓] Audit logging interactions doc reviewed and no conflicts with operational logs pipeline

5) Docs + release readiness
[✓] Docs merged (install steps, dashboard catalog, alert meanings, export examples)
    - Ref: sources/github/redwood-docs/pr-18602-document-private-observability-minimum-pack.json
[✓] Release notes drafted and reviewed by Product + SRE (include upgrade notes + known limitations)
[✓] GA ownership clarified (see below)
[✓] Backport plan confirmed for any P0 fixes found within 2 weeks post-GA

Ownership (post-GA)
- Dashboards bundle (Private minimum pack): Dylan Brooks (primary), Chloe Martin (packaging)
- Prometheus rules/alerts: Sergio Costa (author/primary), Aisha Bello (SLO alignment)
- Helm wiring + values contract: Diego Santos
- Installer preflight/postinstall validation: Diego Santos + Sahana Iyer (test automation)
- Metrics naming/cardinality regressions: Thomas Baird + Nadia Rahman
- Support playbooks/known issues: Dev Patel + Owen Phillips
- SRE validation + paging policy: Rafael Mendes + Tomáš Novák

Exit criteria for closing this ticket
- All checklist sections 1–5 marked complete
- Release branch/tag created for private-2025.09 and communicated in #eng-releases
- Support acknowledges readiness (thumbs-up from Support enablement owners)

Notes / decisions
- Alert philosophy for GA: page-worthy alerts limited to availability + severe saturation/OOM; several advisory alerts are ticket-only or disabled-by-default to reduce noise.
- Metrics cardinality: Private uses capped/aggregated labels for model/route/tenant to protect customer Prometheus; deep per-model analysis is deferred to premium/private custom work.

Rollout plan (GA)
- Stage: internal dogfood private cluster(s) for 1 week
- Then: enable by default for new Private installs; opt-in for existing installs via Helm values
- Backport window: 2 weeks for P0/P1 fixes; otherwise next private release train
